description: Live air quality for any place in Europe, no API key: newest hourly PM2.5, PM10, NO2, ozone and SO2 measured by official EEA monitoring stations (3,700+ active stations in 38 countries incl. UK), the nearest stations to a lat/lon with distance, European Air Quality Index band, data age, hourly history up to 30 days and station lists. Only-new mode returns each new hour once. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/air-quality-api.

country.description: For stations: ISO 2-letter country code, e.g. DE, FR, BG, PL.

hours.description: For history: how many past hours to return (default 24, max 720 = 30 days).

lat.description: Latitude of the place, e.g. 52.52 (Berlin). Europe only (EEA member and cooperating countries, plus UK).

limit.description: For latest: how many nearest stations to return per place (default 3, max 20). For stations mode: max rows (default 500).

locations.description: For latest: up to 25 places as 'lat,lon', e.g. 48.8566,2.3522. Each place returns its nearest stations; rows carry query_location.

mode.description: latest = newest hourly values at the stations nearest to a place (with European Air Quality Index band); history = hourly values of one station for the last N hours; stations = list all stations of a country.

pollutants.description: Any of PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, SO2. Empty = all five.

radius_km.description: For latest: search radius around the place. Default 25, max 200. If no station is inside, the nearest ones are returned with a note.

station.description: EEA station EoI code, e.g. DEBE068 or FR04055. Required for history unless lat/lon is given (then the nearest station is used).

name: air_quality_api
title: Air Quality API - Europe AQI, PM2.5, NO2, No API Key
